r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system led by the prime minister, with the emperor defined in the constitution as a symbol of the state. The Liberal Democratic Party, founded in 1955, has held power for most of the postwar period; the opposition has governed only twice, in 1993 and 2009. So big changes often come from LDP leadership races rather than general elections, and the party's factions had great power in making prime ministers. The prime minister can dissolve the lower house, so elections are sometimes called at the most favorable moment. Whether to revise Article 9 of the pacifist constitution and how much to raise defense spending are long-running political issues.

t.why: One of the world's top four economies and the only Asian member of the G7. It has a security treaty with the United States and hosts US bases, and with the United States, India and Australia it forms the security dialogue known as the Quad. As one of the world's largest creditor nations, even a small move in interest rates by the Bank of Japan shifts the yen and global investment flows. Through aid to developing countries and the Asian Development Bank, it long led infrastructure investment in Asia. It has territorial disputes with China over the Senkaku Islands in the East China Sea and with Russia over the Southern Kurils.
t.rel: It is allied with the United States and hosts US military bases. It disputes the Senkaku Islands with China and the Southern Kurils with Russia, and with South Korea it clashes over history while cooperating.
t.korea: The two established relations with the 1965 Treaty on Basic Relations. Relations have frozen several times over colonial rule, forced labor and the 'comfort women' issue, and after Korea's Supreme Court ordered compensation for forced labor in 2018, Japan's export controls on chip materials in 2019 escalated into a trade fight. After the Korean government proposed a third-party compensation plan in 2023, leaders resumed visits and expanded three-way security cooperation with the United States. Japan's claim to Dokdo, textbooks and visits to the Yasukuni Shrine keep recurring. Japan is Koreans' top overseas travel destination, and the two trade chip materials and parts, so the yen rate is everyday news.
t.know: Japan has tens of thousands of companies more than 100 years old, more than any other country.
etext: It has lost ground in finished products, but it holds large world market shares in intermediate goods such as chip materials and equipment, precision parts and industrial robots. In many fields, factories elsewhere would struggle to run without Japanese parts.
Cars are its biggest export industry. It is strong in hybrid technology and has many plants abroad, making and selling cars around the world.

Having invested its trade surpluses abroad for decades, its net foreign assets are among the largest in the world. These days, dividends and interest from investments abroad generate a bigger surplus than exports of goods.
Its population is shrinking and aging faster than almost anywhere. Government debt is more than twice the size of the economy, making it hard to raise interest rates.
